name: Jobs In Progress
query:
select
	cwo.name as "Job:Link/Coach Work Order:140",
	cwo.customer_name as "Customer::180",
	v.vehicle_name as "Vehicle::130",
	cwo.vehicle_type as "Vehicle Type:Link/Vehicle Type:130",
	cwo.stage as "Stage:Link/Work Stage:130",
	cwo.posting_date as "Job Date:Date:100",
	cwo.expected_delivery_date as "Promised Delivery:Date:130",
	greatest(datediff(curdate(), cwo.expected_delivery_date), 0) as "Days Late:Int:90",
	cwo.total_amount as "Amount:Currency:120"
from `tabCoach Work Order` cwo
left join `tabCoach Work Vehicle` v on v.name = cwo.vehicle
left join `tabWork Stage` ws on ws.name = cwo.stage
where cwo.status = 'Open'
order by ws.sequence asc, cwo.expected_delivery_date asc
